instruction: Tell me the card name I used for my last spotify premium membership payment?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only contains lookup actions and knowledge predicates. World facts (which subscription is the latest, which card paid for it, the card's name) are static in :init; the agent discovers them via show_premium_subscriptions (reveals the payment_card_id of the latest subscription) and show_payment_card (reveals card_name). supervisor-complete-task takes the card name as the answer and the card as a non-API record parameter so its precondition matches the goal; it is the only action producing (task-completed) and every other action requires (not (task-completed)). The reference solution lists 7 API calls; the extra calls are presumably exploratory (e.g. api_docs or show_payment_cards) and not needed for the minimal plan.
